poster_title: ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal

sections.title: ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal
sections.content_md:
ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal

Lanqing Guo 1

sections.title: Problem
sections.content_md: Existing deep shadow removal methods focus on local processing within shadow and non-shadow regions, leading to artifacts at shadow boundaries and inconsistent illumination between regions, while failing to exploit global contextual correlation.

sections.title: Core Idea
sections.content_md: ShadowFormer is a transformer-based encoder-decoder network built on channel attention modules to hierarchically capture global information. In the bottleneck stage, a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) models the contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions across spatial and channel dimensions, enabling non-shadow regions to guide shadow restoration.

sections.title: Why It Matters
sections.content_md: Introduce a Retinex-based shadow model that formulates shadow degradation and motivates exploiting global contexts for shadow removal.

sections.title: Method
sections.content_md:
ShadowFormer is a transformer-based encoder-decoder network built on channel attention modules to hierarchically capture global information. In the bottleneck stage, a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) models the contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions across spatial and channel dimensions, enabling non-shadow regions to guide shadow restoration.

**Key Formulas:**
- $$ \mathbf{I}_{s}= \mathbf{I}_m \odot \mathbf{I}_{s} + (1-\mathbf{I}_m) \odot \mathbf{I}_{ns} $$
  Decomposition of shadow image into shadow and non-shadow regions using a mask.
- $$ \mathbf{I}_{s} = \mathbf{I}_m \odot \mathbf{L}_{s} \odot \mathbf{R} + (1-\mathbf{I}_m) \odot \mathbf{L}_{ns} \odot \mathbf{R} $$
  Retinex-based shadow model: shadow image is a composition of shadow and non-shadow illuminations multiplied by the same reflectance.
- $$ \mathbf{\Sigma}^{ij} = \mathbf{M}^i\oplus \mathbf{M}^j\; \;\;\forall i,j $$
  Correlation map between shadow mask patches i and j, used in SIA.
- $$ \text{SIA}(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{\Sigma}) = \text{softmax}(\frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^T}{d})\mathbf{V} $$
  Shadow-Interaction Attention: reweights attention map by correlation map to emphasize shadow-non-shadow context.
- $$ \mathcal{L}(\mathbf{I}_{g t},\; \hat{\mathbf{I}})=\left\|\mathbf{I}_{g t}-\hat{\mathbf{I}}\right\| $$
  L1 loss between ground truth and predicted shadow-free image.

sections.title: Results
sections.content_md:
| **Metric** | **Value** |
|-----------|----------|
| Datasets | ISTD, ISTD+, SRD |
| Metrics | PSNR, SSIM, RMSE |
| Best Result | ShadowFormer achieves state-of-the-art PSNR/SSIM on all three datasets with up to 150× fewer parameters than competing methods. |

**Takeaways:**
- The proposed method effectively removes shadows while maintaining illumination consistency and reducing boundary artifacts
- with a lightweight model.

sections.title: Contributions
sections.content_md:
- **[theory]** Introduce a Retinex-based shadow model that formulates shadow degradation and motivates exploiting global contexts for shadow removal.
- **[method]** Propose a new single-stage transformer for shadow removal (ShadowFormer) based on a multi-scale channel attention framework.
- **[method]** Propose a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) to exploit global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.
- **[system]** Achieve state-of-the-art performance on ISTD, ISTD+, and SRD datasets with up to 150× fewer model parameters.

sections.title: Key Takeaways
sections.content_md:
1. Introduce a Retinex-based shadow model that formulates shadow degradation and motivates exploiting global contexts for shadow removal.
2. Propose a new single-stage transformer for shadow removal (ShadowFormer) based on a multi-scale channel attention framework.
3. Propose a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) to exploit global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.
4. The proposed method effectively removes shadows while maintaining illumination consistency and reducing boundary artifacts
5. with a lightweight model.
